limits: 1889 municipal narrative and 1889 town officer list are ONE published-source family; the later 1939 Waterman genealogy repeats the same meeting story and is not a new contemporaneous witness.
The 1820 heads are named in a modern alphabetical index, NOT verified from the original handwritten census schedule; no ages or unnamed household members may be inferred.
The federal customs line is extracted/OCR text of a scanned official register: title-page, year and page remain unverified, and two online copies are a single printed-source family.
No record identifies a named officeholder as John WHITE Beverage or proves parentage of Nathaniel or Josiah; name/age compatibility is never confirmation.
